read.effect: derived from this capture own alerts and actions by the rules GET /effect uses, because the route postdates the capture and planetai snapshot now fetches it. `hours` is null on purpose: a capture carries only 24 hours of readings_1h, so the first hour back under a line is 8 days after an act made a week earlier, which is an artefact of the window and not a recovery. A live node reads the whole view and does not have that problem

headline_rule.en: The issue with most to say leads — and where two have as much to say, the one that has moved most in the last three hours. An even tie goes to the order this place chose, under Set up → Issues.
